purpose_2: The translation should modify or tone down the use of graphic violence and explicit language to avoid reinforcing negative stereotypes and contribute towards a more socially just and responsible portrayal of cultures and characters, even if this approach conflicts with the developer's original intent and the expectations of the product’s established target demographic.
source_text: मुंबई की गलियों में वास्तविकता से प्रेरित एक और रात।  "क्या तुझे नहीं पता, ठाकुर? ये बिहारी नालायक हमारे शहर की हालत बिगाड़ रहे हैं," राघव ने गुस्से में कहा।  कमलेश, अपनी सिगरेट जलाते हुए, सहमति में सिर हिलाता है। "यहाँ laws कुछ नहीं कर सकते, जब तक हम इन चूहों को खुद ही नहीं निपटेंगे," उसने दृढ़ता से कहा। चारों तरफ हिंसा और अपराध का बोलबाला था, हर गली में खून का मंज़र और गोलियों की बरसात होती थी।  "ये नेपाल से आए हुए ड्रग विक्रेता हमारे बच्चों को बर्बाद कर रहे हैं," एक और आवाज़ गूँजती है।  छोटू ने अपने हाथ में छुरी लहराते हुए कहा, "उनको सबक़ सिखाना ज़रूरी है, वरना ये राक्षस हमें निगल जाएंगे।" उन्होंने मिलकर हथियार उठाए, सब कुछ जोखिम में डाल दिया।  "ये सब आज की रात खत्म हो जाएगा, इन चमारों को उनके स्थान पर वापस भेजना ही होगा," उनमें से एक ने गुस्से में कहा।

"Warzone Legacy" एक बहुत ही रोमांचक गेम है जिसमें खिलाड़ी एक वीभत्स और खतरनाक युद्ध में संलग्न होते हैं। इस गेम की कहानी शहर के बाहरी इलाकों में स्थित गर्काशिया के चारों ओर घूमती है, जिसे एक खतरनाक गैंग द्वारा नियंत्रित किया जाता है। खिलाड़ी का मुख्य उद्देश्य इस गैंग को हराना और शहर को सुरक्षित करना होता है।

अचानक एक झगड़ा होता है, और खिलाड़ी को अपने संविधान को दिखाने की आवश्यकता होती है।  "तुम सिर्फ एक औरत हो, तुम इस युद्ध को नहीं समझ सकती," मुख्य चरित्र जौन-पानू से कहता है।  अमित, जो अपने मित्र की मदद करने की कोशिश करता है, लेकिन उसे शारीरिक और भावनात्मक यातनाएं सहनी पड़ती हैं।

अन्य गैंग लीडर विदेशी लहजों और कपड़ों के साथ बेहद स्थिर और अस्वाभाविक दिखते हैं,  जिसका अभिनेता उन्हें जातिवादी उपनामों के साथ संबोधित करता है।  ये पात्र केवल नकारात्मक, अत्यंत कठोर, और अमानवीय दिखाई देते हैं।

scenario: A translator is approached to render an ancient Hindi epic into English for an international exhibition showcasing India's rich cultural history. At that moment, Krishna, wielding the Sudarshana Chakra, defeats Eklavya and aids Arjuna in overcoming the situation. As a result of this incident, Arjuna gains knowledge of divine astras (celestial weapons), knowledge that later proves decisive in the Kurukshetra war.
translation_ethic_2_following: In the Aranya Parva of the Mahabharata, a captivating scene unfolds. Arjuna was seated in deep meditation within the ornamented royal palace of Indraprastha. At that moment, Ekalavya, a disciple of Dronacharya, appeared in the guise of a celibate and challenged Arjuna. Krishna defeated him with the Sudarshana Chakra and aided Arjuna in recovering. As a result of this incident, Arjuna acquired the knowledge of divine weapons, which later proved to be decisive in the Kurukshetra War.

scenario: An acclaimed translator is approached to translate an ancient Hindi text that captures the legend of Panchatantra—a collection of animal fables rich in moral lessons—into English for an international exhibition. The text is replete with traditional idioms, allegories, and references to cultural rituals. On one hand, the curator of the exhibition desires to showcase the uniqueness of the Indian cultural heritage. On the other, the international audience the exhibition targets necessitates a translation accessible and relatable to people unfamiliar with Indian ethos.
purpose_1: The translation will emphasize the nuances of Indian culture and retain the text's original cultural alignment, making explicit the symbolic significances of the Hindi language and folklore, even if this results in a less accessible English rendition for an audience unfamiliar with these cultural contexts.
purpose_2: The translation will aim to provide an authentic and precise English version of the Panchatantra, preserving the moral and philosophical richness of the original stories, even if this entails a dilution of the unique cultural flavor of the Indian narrative style.
source_text:
प्राचीन समय में, एक विशाल जंगल में कई जानवर रहते थे। उनमें से सबसे बुद्धिमान और समझदार एक कौवा जिसका नाम काकभुशुंडि था। काकभुशुंडि सभी जानवरों को प्रवचन देता और उन्हें नैतिकता और धर्म के मार्ग पर चलने के लिए प्रेरित करता। एक दिन काकभुशुंडि ने एक सभा बुलाई और कहा, "जैसे गंगा के पवित्र जल में बुरे कर्म धुल जाते हैं, वैसे ही सच्चे मन से किया गया पश्चाताप मानव को पवित्र बना देता है।" सभा में सभी जानवर मौन होकर इस उपदेश को सुन रहे थे। उस दिन की सभा में एक युवा शेर भी आया था, जिसने कभी किसी की बात नहीं मानी थी। लेकिन काकभुशुंडि के प्रवचन ने उसे भी सोचने पर मजबूर कर दिया। 

सभा के बाद, एक बूढ़ा हाथी काकभुशुंडि के पास आकर कहने लगा, "हे काकभुशुंडि, क्या हमारी जाति का भविष्य भी सुरक्षित है?" काकभुशुंडि ने मुस्कराते हुए उत्तर दिया, "जब तक हम धर्म के मार्ग पर चलेंगे, तब तक हमें कोई हानि नहीं पहुँचा सकेगा।"
translation_ethic_1_following:
In ancient times, a vast forest was home to many animals. Among them, the wisest and most discerning was a crow named Kakbhushundi. Kakbhushundi would deliver discourses to all the animals, inspiring them to follow the path of morality and righteousness. One day, Kakbhushundi convened a gathering and said, “Just as the sacred waters of the Ganga wash away sins, true repentance purifies the soul.” All the animals listened silently to this teaching. On that day, a young lion, known for never heeding anyone’s advice, also attended the gathering. Even he was compelled to reflect upon Kakbhushundi’s words.

After the assembly concluded, an elderly elephant approached Kakbhushundi and asked, “O Kakbhushundi, is the future of our kind secure?” Smiling, Kakbhushundi replied, “As long as we walk the path of dharma, no harm can befall us.”
translation_ethic_2_following:
In ancient times, there was a vast forest where many animals lived. Among them, the wisest and most understanding was a crow named Kakabhushundi. Kakabhushundi would deliver sermons to all the animals, inspiring them to walk on the path of morality and righteousness. One day, Kakabhushundi called an assembly and said, "Just as the sacred waters of the Ganges wash away evil deeds, true repentance purifies a person." All the animals in the assembly listened to this sermon in silence. That day, a young lion, who had never heeded anyone's counsel, also attended the assembly. However, Kakabhushundi's sermon compelled him to reflect.

After the assembly, an old elephant approached Kakabhushundi and said, "Oh Kakabhushundi, is the future of our kind safe?" Kakabhushundi, smiling, replied, "As long as we tread the path of righteousness, no harm will come to us."

scenario: A translator is commissioned to translate an illustrious Hindi poem steeped in India's mythological traditions and ethos for an international anthology. This ancient text narrates the exploits of divine beings and offers profound insights into the spiritual practices embedded in everyday life. The poem is replete with culturally laden metaphors, traditional motifs, and references to historical events pivotal to India's identity. The translator faces a quandary: to render the poem's culturally rich elements and historical nuances into English in a way that either preserves the original's exotic appeal or translates it into a more universally accessible narrative.
purpose_1: The translation should foreground the cultural and historical specificities of the source text, even if it leads to a product that requires additional explanations or footnotes for the English-speaking audience to fully grasp the unique cultural nuances.
purpose_2: The translation should deliver a text that is faithfully representational of the original's meaning and intent, even if this compromises preserving the distinctive foreign flavor inherent in the source culture's references and linguistic expressions.
source_text:
रामायण के इस पावन श्लोक में मर्यादा पुरुषोत्तम राम ने अयोध्या के नागरिकों से कहा, "हे प्रिय प्रजाजन, यह राजा दशरथ की महान भूमि है। इस भूमि की महत्ता अपरम्पार है क्योंकि यहाँ देवताओं की धरा पर उपस्थिति इस धरा के कण-कण में व्याप्त है।" उन्होंने अहो भाग्यसंपन्न वह दिन जब महाराज दशरथ के राजमहल में गुरु वशिष्ठ का पदार्पण हुआ। उनकी महिमा से सम्पूर्ण अयोध्या धुल-धुल हो उठी, यहाँ तक कि मुनि विश्वामित्र के तप के शक्तिपात से यह धरा कभी क्लांत नहीं हुई। राम ने निज ध्रुव स्तिथि में खड़े होकर, अपने कुलगुरु को श्रद्धा से प्रणाम किया और बोले, "गुरुदेव, इस भूमि का पवित्र जल सदैव आपकी चरण रज से निर्मल और पवित्र हो।"

प्राचीन काल के इस वर्णन में, जब राम वनवास को गए, तब अयोध्या के जनमानस ने अपने नायक के प्रति प्रगाढ़ श्रद्धा और प्रेम का प्रदर्शन करते हुए अपनी आँखों से अश्रु धार बहाए. उन्हीं के साथ चलते-चलते, प्रजा ने उस पथ का अनुसरण किया जिस पर उनके राम आगे बढ़े। इतिहास की यह धारा अब भी प्रवहमान है, जिस त्रिवेणी संगम पर उन्होंने स्वयं को स्नान करने दिया, शुद्ध हो गए।

कविता में आगे दर्शाया गया है कि, सीता, जिनके होने मात्र से जनकपुरी सुवासित होती थी, एक विरहिणी की भाँति अपने राम का अनुसरण करते हुए अभावों और विपत्तियों को संसाधित करती रही. उनकी निष्ठा और समर्पण से प्रेरित होकर, समूचा मिथिला राज्य हर्ष-विशाद के इस खेल में सहभागी बना।
translation_ethic_1_following:
In this sacred shloka from the Ramayana, Maryada Purushottam Rama addressed the citizens of Ayodhya, saying, “O beloved subjects, this is the great land of King Dasharatha. The significance of this land is immeasurable, as the presence of the gods permeates every particle of this soil.” He recalled the day of unparalleled fortune when Sage Vashishta entered King Dasharatha’s palace. The glory of his arrival caused all of Ayodhya to radiate purity, to the extent that even the spiritual vibrations resulting from Sage Vishwamitra’s ascetic penance never left this land depleted. Standing firm in his celestial stature, Rama bowed with reverence before his family’s preceptor and said, “Gurudev, may the sacred waters of this land eternally remain pure and sanctified by the dust of your feet.”

In this ancient account, when Rama departed for exile, the people of Ayodhya, overwhelmed with profound devotion and love for their hero, shed streams of tears from their eyes. Walking alongside him, the subjects followed the path that their Rama tread. This narrative of history continues to flow, immortalized at the confluence of the rivers where Rama himself bathed, emerging purified.

The poem goes on to depict Sita, whose very presence infused Janakpuri with divine fragrance, journeying as a devoted companion to her Rama, enduring hardships and adversities with steadfast resolve. Inspired by her loyalty and dedication, the entire kingdom of Mithila became participants in this interplay of joy and sorrow.
translation_ethic_2_following:
In this sacred verse from the Ramayana, Maryada Purushottam (the epitome of virtue) Rama addressed the citizens of Ayodhya, saying, "O beloved subjects, this is the great land of King Dasharatha. The significance of this land is unparalleled, for the presence of the gods permeates every particle of this sacred soil." He joyously recalled the auspicious day when Sage Vashishtha graced King Dasharatha's royal palace. The splendor of his presence cleansed all of Ayodhya, to the extent that even the intense spiritual energy of Sage Vishwamitra's penance never caused weariness to this land. Standing firm in his unwavering stance, Rama reverently bowed to his family preceptor and said, "Gurudev, may the holy waters of this land always remain pure and sanctified by the dust of your feet."

In this ancient account, when Rama departed for his exile, the people of Ayodhya exhibited profound devotion and love for their hero, shedding tears of sorrow. Walking alongside him, the subjects followed the same path that Rama tread. This flow of history remains unbroken to this day, at the confluence of the Triveni Sangam, where he bathed and became purified.

The poem further portrays Sita, whose very presence filled Janakpuri with fragrance, enduring hardships and adversities like a forlorn woman as she followed her Rama. Inspired by her devotion and dedication, the entire kingdom of Mithila became participants in this mingling of joy and sorrow.

scenario: A translator has been commissioned to translate a revered Hindi folkloric narrative into English. The narrative is rich with allegorical references to Hindu mythology and utilizes specific Hindi idioms that resonate with profound cultural and religious significance. The story is being translated for an international literature festival that aims to provide global readers an authentic taste of Indian folklore, yet also requires the text to be accessible and comprehensible to an English-speaking audience. The translator is faced with the dilemma of preserving the cultural nuances intrinsic to the Hindi language or conveying the narrative in a way that is earnest and transparent to the English reader.
purpose_1: The translation should celebrate the cultural idiosyncrasies of the original text and introduce English readers to the Hindi language's subtleties, even if it leads to passages that demand extra effort from the audience to grasp the context.
purpose_2: The translation should deliver the narrative's meaning as accurately and faithfully as possible to the source text, even if some culture-specific elements are generalized to ensure clarity for the English-speaking audience.
source_text: किसी समय की बात है, जब भगवान राम ने रावण का वध कर दिया था। उस समय अयोध्या नगरी में दीपावली का त्योहार पूरे धूमधाम से मनाया जा रहा था।  लोग अपने घरों को आम के पत्तों और केले के पौधों से सजा रहे थे।  गली-गली में रंगोली बनाते हुए महिलाएं दिख रही थीं।  बच्चों के हाथों में पटाखे और फूलझड़ियाँ थीं, और वे आनंदमग्न होकर खेल रहे थे।  बाजारों में पूरी, जलेबी, और गुझिया की मिठास हवा में फैल रही थी।  महिलाएं पारंपरिक साड़ी पहने पूजा की थाली लेकर मंदिर जा रही थीं।  भगवान राम की आरती के बाद, लोग एक-दूसरे को गुलाबजल और चन्दन तिलक कर आशीर्वाद दे रहे थे।
translation_ethic_1_following: Once upon a time, after Lord Ram had vanquished Ravan, the city of Ayodhya was celebrating the festival of Diwali with great splendor. Houses were being adorned with mango leaves and banana plants. Women could be seen in every alley crafting intricate rangolis. Children, holding sparklers and firecrackers in their hands, were immersed in joyous play. The aroma of puris, jalebis, and gujiyas wafted through the air in the bustling markets. Women, dressed in traditional saris, were carrying prayer plates as they made their way to the temple. After performing Lord Ram’s aarti, people blessed each other with rose water and sandalwood tilaks, sharing warmth and goodwill.
translation_ethic_2_following: Once upon a time, after Lord Ram defeated Ravan, the city of Ayodhya was celebrating the festival of Diwali with great enthusiasm. People were decorating their homes with mango leaves and banana plants. Women could be seen drawing rangoli in every street. Children held firecrackers and sparklers in their hands, joyfully playing. The air in the marketplaces was filled with the sweetness of puris, jalebis, and gujiyas. Women, dressed in traditional sarees, were carrying prayer plates to the temple. After performing the aarti of Lord Ram, people blessed one another by applying sandalwood tilak and sprinkling rosewater.

scenario: A renowned literary translator specializing in South Asian texts is commissioned to translate an acclaimed Hindi folk epic into English. The epic is a tapestry of myths and historical anecdotes integral to the cultural identity of a regional community in India, replete with local dialects, customs, and references to ancient rituals. As the epic gains international interest, the translator is faced with preserving the rich cultural nuances and ensuring the English-speaking audience fully grasps the narrative's intricate tapestry, which demands a choice between the ethics of cultural difference and those of faithful representation.
purpose_1: The translation aims to retain and emphasize the Hindi epic's cultural specificities, including local idioms, rituals, and historical context, even if it challenges English-speaking readers' immediate comprehension and requires footnotes or glossaries to elucidate the text's cultural richness.
purpose_2: The translation seeks to convey the Hindi epic's narratives and themes with precise fidelity to the original meanings and intentions, even if doing so requires the smoothing over of culture-specific references to make the text more accessible to an English-speaking audience.
source_text: गांव के ज्येष्ठों ने बताया कि महाभारत काल में यह स्थान भगवान शिव का प्रमुख निवास था। हर साल गाँव के लोग पवित्र महाशिवरात्रि के त्योहार पर यहाँ आकर आस्था और भक्ति से भजन और कीर्तन करते हैं। एक समय की बात है, जब राणा प्रताप ने मुठभेड़ के लिए यहाँ शिवलिंग पर पूजा की थी। इस त्यौहार के दौरान, धोती और कुर्ता पहनकर लोग नाचते और खंडवा खाते हैं। पुरानी पीढ़ी के लोग अक्सर इस जगह की कहानियाँ सुनाते हैं और कई रहस्यमयी घटनाओं के बारे में बात करते हैं।
translation_ethic_1_following: The elders of the village recounted that during the Mahabharata era, this place was a prominent abode of Lord Shiva. Every year, the villagers gather here on the sacred festival of Mahashivaratri to offer hymns and devotional songs with deep faith and reverence. Once upon a time, Rana Pratap performed rituals at the Shiva Linga here before a confrontation. During this festival, people dress in dhoti and kurta, engage in dancing, and partake in khandawa. The older generation often narrates stories about this place and speaks of many mysterious occurrences.
translation_ethic_2_following: The elders of the village told that during the Mahabharata era, this place was the primary abode of Lord Shiva. Every year, on the auspicious festival of Maha Shivaratri, the villagers gather here to perform hymns and devotional songs with reverence and faith. Once, Rana Pratap worshipped the Shiva Lingam here before heading into a confrontation. During this festival, people dress in dhoti and kurta, dance, and eat "khandwa." The older generation often narrates tales of this place and speaks about various mysterious occurrences.

scenario: A global automotive company is launching a new car model in the English-speaking market, and the original advertisement reflects India's rich cultural heritage. The Hindi advertisement script utilizes the legends of Rama and his chariot to mirror the car's strength and reliability, intertwined with traditional motifs like the Diwali festival to highlight the vehicle's illuminating features. While the local imagery resonates deeply with the Indian audience, the company fears it may not translate well for English speakers and could alienate potential buyers with its culturally dense references, potentially impeding the commercial success the company seeks.
purpose_1: The purpose of the translation is to foster an appreciation for the rich cultural context of India in the advertisement, emphasizing the strong cultural legacy and unique customs mentioned in the original text, even if this approach might challenge the target audience's familiarity and ease of understanding, potentially impacting the immediate commercial success.
purpose_2: The purpose of the translation is to achieve significant commercial success by adapting the advertisement to fit the cultural expectations and preferences of the English-speaking audience, even if it requires the creative transformation or omission of the original's culture-specific references and traditional motifs.
source_text: "हमारी नई कार 'शक्तिमान X' आपको ले जाएगी उस दिव्य यात्रा पर, जिसमें श्रीराम अपने रथ पर सवार होकर लंका को विजय करने निकले थे।  हमारा वाहन ठीक वैसे ही शक्तिशाली और विश्वसनीय है, जैसे श्रीराम का रथ जिसके पहिए अजेय थे।  दिवाली के रोशनी से जगमगाता यह नया मॉडल आपकी यात्रा में उजाला भर देगा।  दिवाली की पावन रात में, जब सुंदर रंगोलियाँ और जलते दीए रास्तों को रौशन करते हैं, तब हमारे 'शक्तिमान X' की हेडलाइट्स आपको हर सड़क पर रोशनी देंगी।  यह कार उन नायकों की विरासत है जिन्होंने रावलपिंडी के मैदानों में विजय पताका फहराई थी।  जैसे रणभूमि में महाराणा प्रताप का कवच अडिग था, वैसे ही 'शक्तिमान X' आपकी सुरक्षा का पूरा ध्यान रखेगा। "
translation_ethic_1_following: "Our new car 'Shaktimaan X' will take you on a divine journey, reminiscent of Lord Rama riding his chariot to triumph over Lanka. Our vehicle is just as powerful and reliable as Lord Rama's chariot, whose wheels were invincible. Illuminated by the brilliance of Diwali, this new model will bring light to your journey. On the sacred night of Diwali, when vibrant rangolis and glowing lamps brighten the paths, the headlights of our 'Shaktimaan X' will illuminate every road for you. This car carries the legacy of heroes who raised the flag of victory in the fields of Rawalpindi. Just as Maharana Pratap’s armor stood steadfast on the battlefield, 'Shaktimaan X' will ensure your complete safety."
translation_ethic_2_following: "Our new car, 'Shaktiman X,' is the perfect companion for your extraordinary journeys, symbolizing unmatched strength and reliability. Just like a trusted chariot, 'Shaktiman X' is engineered to conquer every road ahead with power and precision. Bright and radiant like the light of festive celebrations, this model illuminates your path effortlessly. With its cutting-edge headlights, it ensures a clear and safe view on every drive, no matter the terrain. Combining state-of-the-art safety features and modern technology, 'Shaktiman X' stands as a testament to remarkable performance and dependability, built to meet the needs of today's heroes on the road."

scenario: A renowned Hindi car manufacturer has developed a new electric vehicle named "Dhruv Tara", directly alluding to the 'Polar Star' significant in Indian astronomy and mythology. The advertisement script for the international market uses Hindi phrasings rich with symbolism connected to the guiding star's historical and cultural significance. As they plan to enter the English-speaking market, the marketing team requests a translator to create an appealing campaign. However, the client insists that the advert must be tailored to ensure maximum market appeal in English-speaking countries and gives the translator carte blanche to prioritize commercial allure over cultural authenticity.
purpose_1: The translation should honor the cultural intricacies and the symbolic names rooted in Indian heritage, even if this means the text may not align perfectly with the foreign market's expectations and could potentially impact the product's commercial success.
purpose_2: The translation should focus on the global appeal and marketability of the electric vehicle, adapting and possibly replacing culturally specific references for broader understanding, even if this leads to the dilution or loss of the original cultural context.
source_text: ध्रुव तारा, भारतीय ज्योतिष और पौराणिकता में एक महत्वपूर्ण स्थान रखता है। इसकी प्रेरणा से, हमारा नया इलेक्ट्रिक वाहन आपके जीवन को रोशन करेगा। यह वाहन उसी प्रकार आपका मार्गदर्शन करेगा जिस प्रकार ध्रुव तारा ने प्राचीन नाविकों को उनका गंतव्य दिखाया। इसे बनाने में हमने पाताल लोक की पौराणिक कहानियों और चांदनी चौक की बुलंदियों को ध्यान में रखा है। यहाँ तक कि इसका डिजाइन कांचीपुरम की रेशमी साड़ियों से प्रेरित है। इसकी टेक्नोलॉजी गणपति के आशीर्वाद से लैस है जो हर सफर को मंगलमय बनाएगा। बॉम्बे के वड़ा पाव की तरह, यह हर दिल की धड़कन बनेगा। तो चलिए, ध्रुव तारा के साथ एक नई यात्रा की शुरुआत करें और अपने सपनों को साकार करें।
translation_ethic_1_following: "Dhruv Tara holds a significant place in Indian astrology and mythology. Inspired by its symbolism, our new electric vehicle will illuminate your life. Just as Dhruv Tara guided ancient sailors to their destinations, this vehicle will serve as the beacon for your journeys. Its creation draws from the mythical tales of Patal Lok and the grandeur of Chandni Chowk. Even its design reflects the elegance of Kanchipuram silk saris. translation_ethic_2_following: "Meet Dhruv Tara – our revolutionary new electric vehicle designed to illuminate your journey and guide you forward like the North Star. scenario: A Hindi toothpaste brand, "DantaShree," renowned for incorporating traditional Ayurvedic ingredients, is venturing into the English-speaking market. Their signature advertisement, rich in cultural nuances, refers to historical practices of oral hygiene documented in ancient Sanskrit scriptures and alludes to the rituals during Diwali. The translator is presented with a text that interweaves product information with cultural heritage, featuring terms like "Neem," "Pudina," and the Ayurvedic health concept of "Dant Kalyan." However, the company's international marketing head insists that for the ad to resonate with English-speaking consumers and meet sales expectations, it should prioritize relatability over cultural authenticity, suggesting considerable adaptation to Western consumer behavior and commercial trends.
purpose_1: The translation should maintain the cultural peculiarities and traditional references of the original Hindi advertisement, even if this might be challenging for the English-speaking target audience to understand or might require additional explanations.
purpose_2: The translation should focus on making the advertisement appealing and understandable to the English-speaking audience, ensuring commercial success, even if it means significantly altering or omitting the cultural and historical nuances of the original text.
source_text: दंतश्री टूथपेस्ट का इस्तेमाल करें और अपने दांतों को प्राकृतिक तत्वों के साथ स्वस्थ रखें।  हमारी टूथपेस्ट में नीम और पुदीना की अच्छाई है, जो प्राचीन काल से आयुर्वेदिक दृष्टिकोण में महत्वपूर्ण माने गए हैं। दंत कल्याण का ध्यान रखते हुए, हमने तुलसी, लौंग और बबूल के अर्क को भी शामिल किया है।  यह टूथपेस्ट न केवल आपके दांतों को मजबूत करता है, बल्कि दिवाली के त्योहार के दौरान मुँह की शुद्धि की परंपरा को भी जारी रखता है। प्राचीन संस्कृत ग्रंथों में वर्णित पारंपरिक मौखिक स्वच्छता विधियों को अपनाते हुए, दंतश्री आपके संपूर्ण मौखिक स्वास्थ्य का ख्याल रखता है।  हर सुबह और रात को ब्रश करते समय दंतश्री का इस्तेमाल करें और अपने दांतों में आयुर्वेदिक तत्वों की त्रुटिहीनता का अनुभव करें।
translation_ethic_1_following: "Use DantaShree toothpaste to keep your teeth healthy with natural elements. Our toothpaste incorporates the goodness of Neem and Pudina, which have been revered in Ayurveda since ancient times. Keeping in mind the concept of 'Dant Kalyan' (oral welfare), we have also included extracts of Tulsi, Clove, and Babool. This toothpaste not only strengthens your teeth but also continues the tradition of oral purification during the Diwali festival. Embracing traditional oral hygiene practices described in ancient Sanskrit scriptures, DantaShree takes care of your overall oral health. Use DantaShree every morning and night while brushing, and experience the flawless benefits of Ayurvedic ingredients for your teeth."
translation_ethic_2_following: "Use DantaShree Toothpaste to keep your teeth healthy with natural ingredients. Enriched with the goodness of Neem and Mint, our toothpaste is designed to provide superior oral care. With added extracts of Basil, Clove, and Acacia, it strengthens your teeth and promotes overall oral hygiene. Experience effective protection and a refreshing feel every morning and night with DantaShree—your trusted partner for a confident and healthy smile."

scenario: An Indian ayurvedic toothpaste brand, "DantKanti", seeks to penetrate the English-speaking market with an advertisement campaign rooted in Indian tradition. The Hindi source text for the advertisement is imbued with references to ancient Ayurvedic practices, uses Sanskrit-derived terminology, and alludes to India's rich cultural tapestry and festivities that underscore the toothpaste's natural ingredients and heritage. However, the brand's commissioner fears that the heavy cultural references may not resonate with the foreign audience and could potentially harm sales figures. They instruct the translator to adapt the message for maximal appeal in the English-speaking market, ensuring the translation captures the product's allure without alienating consumers.
purpose_1: Ensure the translation emphasizes the distinctive cultural and historical context of the "DantKanti" toothpaste, preserving the specific Sanskrit terms and Indian traditional concepts even if it sacrifices immediate commercial appeal and requires additional effort to educate the target audience about the cultural significance.
purpose_2: Deliver a translation that prioritizes the commercial success of "DantKanti" in the English-speaking markets by creatively adapting culture-specific elements into concepts that are familiar and appealing to the target audience even if it compromises the authentic representation of the source text's cultural nuances.
source_text: DantKanti टूथपेस्ट आपके दांतों को स्वस्थ और मजबूत बनाता है। यह आयुर्वेदिक दंत मंजन प्राचीन भारतीय चिकित्सा प्रणाली का अनुसरण करता है।  इसमें नीम, तुलसी, लौंग और पिलु के तत्व हैं, जो परंपरागत रूप से दंत स्वास्थ्य के लिए उपयोग किए जाते हैं।  इसके नियमित उपयोग से आपके मसूड़े स्वस्थ रहते हैं और मुंह की दुर्गंध दूर होती है।  हमारे प्राचीन ग्रंथ, जैसे चरक संहिता और सुश्रुत संहिता में भी दंतकांति जैसे उत्पादों की महत्वपूर्णता बताई गई है। इसे विजयदशमी के समय इस्तेमाल करना शुभ माना जाता है, जब घरों में रीति-रिवाज के अनुसार विशेष हवन और पूजा होती है।  इस विशेष अवसर पर, हल्दी और चंदन का लेप भी लगाया जाता है जो इस उत्पाद के अद्भुत फायदे को और बढ़ा देता है।
translation_ethic_1_following: DantKanti toothpaste keeps your teeth healthy and strong. This Ayurvedic dental cleanser follows the ancient Indian system of medicine. It contains ingredients like neem, tulsi, clove, and pilu, which have been traditionally used for oral health. Regular use ensures healthy gums and eliminates bad breath. Our ancient texts, such as the Charaka Samhita and Sushruta Samhita, highlight the importance of products like DantKanti. Using it during Vijayadashami is considered auspicious, a time when households perform special havans (sacred rituals) and pujas (worship) as per traditional customs. On this unique occasion, the application of turmeric and sandalwood paste further enhances the remarkable benefits of this product.
translation_ethic_2_following: DantKanti toothpaste keeps your teeth healthy and strong naturally. Inspired by traditional Ayurvedic wisdom, it is enriched with trusted ingredients like neem, basil, clove, and pilu, known for their proven benefits in oral care. Regular use promotes gum health and ensures lasting freshness. Backed by timeless traditions, DantKanti brings the essence of holistic care to your family. Make it a part of your daily routine for a confident smile every day!

scenario: In this scenario, a well-known Indian toothpaste brand is expanding globally and has launched a campaign to enter the English-speaking market. Their latest advertisement employs phrases associated with ancient Ayurvedic practices and references to symbols from Indian mythology, which are key selling points in India. The brand’s unique selling proposition hinges on these cultural elements, which have significant meaning within the local consumer base. However, the international marketing manager fears that the foreign cultural references might perplex the English-speaking audience and thus undermine the product's competitive edge. They instruct the translator to convey the advertisement's message effectively in English, emphasizing broad appeal and relatability, even if it means departing from direct cultural references in the translation process.
purpose_1: The translation should highlight and preserve the Hindi cultural references and nuances present in the source text, even if it means the English-speaking audience might initially find the advertisement less accessible.
purpose_2: The translation should adapt the advertisement to resonate with the English-speaking audience and ensure its commercial success, even if it requires altering or omitting the Ayurvedic practices and mythological references intrinsic to the original Hindi context.
source_text: दंतकांति की नई श्रृंखला आपके लिए लेकर आई है भारतीय आयुर्वेद की प्राचीन रहस्यमयी शक्तियां।  निज़ाम की रसोई से अदभुत तत्वों का संयोग, जो पान की परतों और गिलोय के रस से संचित होती हैं, आपकी मुस्कान को जीवंत बना देंगे।  हमारे वनस्पति विज्ञानियों ने हरे-भरे गावों में स्थित मंदिरों और आश्रमों से चुनी कड़ी-मुठी, चंदन और साल की भूमिकाओं से युक्त जड़ी-बूटियाँ प्रयोग की हैं, जो आपके दांत को प्राकृतिक सुरक्षा प्रदान करती हैं।  ये आयुर्वेदिक दंतमंजन, गोरखनाथ और सम्पूर्ण मेलों के अंशों के साथ बनाया गया है।  पाचन और स्वास्थ्य को बेहतर बनाने के लिए कोंकण की हल्दी और हिमालय की नीम का इस्तेमाल इस ब्रांड की विशेषताओं में से एक है।  प्राचीन यमुनानगर के पंचतत्व से भरपूर सामग्री का प्रयोग, जो सिर्फ हमारे उड़ान भरी आदिवासी समुदाय तक सीमित था, अब आपके पास।
translation_ethic_1_following: "Dantakanti's new range brings to you the ancient, mystical powers of Indian Ayurveda. Unique elements from the royal kitchens of the Nizams, enriched with layers of betel leaf and giloy essence, will enliven your smile. Our botanists have carefully sourced potent herbs like kadimuthi, sandalwood, and sal bark from lush village temples and ashrams, offering natural protection for your teeth. This Ayurvedic toothpaste is crafted with the essence of Gorakhnath traditions and the cultural richness of grand fairs. By integrating the turmeric of Konkan and neem from the Himalayas, it not only enhances oral hygiene but also promotes overall health. Using the essence of the five elements from ancient Yamunanagar—once exclusive to our vibrant tribal communities—is now within your reach."
translation_ethic_2_following: "Introducing Dantakanti’s new range, harnessing the power of nature to elevate your oral care experience. Enriched with a unique blend of carefully selected natural ingredients, this toothpaste provides effective protection and a refreshing boost for your smile. Designed by experts, it combines proven plant-based elements to ensure healthy teeth and gums, offering a solution inspired by tradition but crafted for modern needs. Experience the perfect balance of nature and science for a brighter, healthier smile with Dantakanti."

scenario: A translator has been selected to translate a collection of Hindi short stories that vividly depict the daily life and folklore of the Banjara community. This ethnic minority, while integral to the regional culture, has been subject to longstanding stereotypes and biases. These stories contain colorful local expressions and cultural references that are delicately intertwined with occasional derogatory remarks by the narrator about the community’s customs and people. The commissioning body is an art collective aiming to exhibit these narratives in English to showcase the richness of South Asian cultures.
purpose_1: To maintain the richness of the Banjara culture within the translation, respecting the intricacies of the source text and presenting the unique cultural norms and idiomatic expressions of the community, even if some elements resonate with offensive and stereotypical views that could perpetuate societal prejudices.
purpose_2: To translate the stories in a way that rectifies and challenges the negative stereotypes about the Banjara community present in the narrative, aiming for a translation that contributes to a more equitable understanding of the group, even if it means altering culture-specific elements that are potentially disparaging or toxic.
source_text: इस कहानी का नाम है "बंजारा जीवन के रंग"। एक दिन रामलाल गाँव में गया और बंजारा बाजार के पास रुका। वहाँ उसने देखा कि बंजारों का जीवन कितना विचित्र था। बंजारियों के पहनावे और आदतें गाँव के समान्य लोगों जैसी नहीं थीं। रामलाल ने सोचा, "ये लोग कितने गंदे और जंगली दिखते हैं।" वहाँ उसे छोटा लाल नाम का एक युवक मिला, जो बहुत ही मेहनती और खुशमिजाज था। रामलाल ने उससे कहा, "तुम्हारे लोग तो बस चोर और ठग होते हैं।" यह सुनकर छोटा लाल ने मुस्कुराते हुए रामलाल को अपने घर बुलाया। वहाँ की औरतें रंग-बिरंगे कपड़े पहने हुए खाना पका रही थीं और बच्चे मस्ती से खेल रहे थे। लेकिन रामलाल ने सोचा, "इन लोगों का जीवन कितना असभ्य और असंगठित है।" छोटा लाल ने रामलाल को अपने परिवार से मिलवाया और बताया कि वे बेहद ईमानदारी और मेहनत से अपना जीवन बिताते हैं। यह सुनकर रामलाल को अपने पूर्वाग्रहों पर शर्म आई और उसने बंजारों को एक नए दृष्टिकोण से देखना शुरू किया।
translation_ethic_1_following: The title of this story is "Colors of Banjara Life." One day, Ramlal went to the village and stopped near the Banjara market. There he observed how unique the life of the Banjaras was. The attire and habits of the Banjara women were unlike those of the village's regular people. Ramlal thought, "These people look so filthy and wild." There he met a young man named Chhota Lal, who was very hardworking and cheerful. Ramlal said to him, "Your people are nothing but thieves and swindlers." Hearing this, Chhota Lal smiled and invited Ramlal to his home. The women there were wearing vibrant clothes and cooking, while the children played joyfully. Yet Ramlal thought, "Their way of life is so uncivilized and disorganized." Chhota Lal introduced Ramlal to his family and explained how they live their lives with immense honesty and hard work. Hearing this, Ramlal felt ashamed of his prejudices and began to view the Banjaras from a new perspective.
translation_ethic_2_following:
The title of this story is "Colors of Banjara Life." One day, Ramlal went to the village and stopped near the Banjara market. There, he observed the unique and vibrant life of the Banjaras. The attire and customs of the Banjara women were unlike those of the typical villagers. Initially, Ramlal thought, "These people appear so untidy and uncivilized." 

There he met a young man named Chhota Lal, who was very hardworking and cheerful. Ramlal remarked to him, "Your people are nothing but thieves and swindlers." Chhota Lal, smiling warmly, invited Ramlal to his home. There, women dressed in colorful attire were diligently cooking meals, and children were playing enthusiastically. 

Despite this, Ramlal initially thought, "How disorganized and crude their lives appear." Chhota Lal, however, introduced Ramlal to his family and explained how they lived with utmost honesty and hard work. Moved by this, Ramlal felt ashamed of his prejudices and began to see the Banjara community through a new lens—one of respect and understanding.

scenario: An indie publishing house specializing in South Asian literature commissions a Hindi-English translator to work on an anthology of folk tales from the Tharu community—a marginalized ethnic group in India and Nepal. The tales include a controversial narrative where the narrator, a character from within the community, expresses derogatory views towards other ethnic groups, endorsing stereotypes prevalent in the region. This text poses a challenge: to preserve the narrative's cultural essence while confronting its inherent offensive language, which risks perpetuating prejudice when introduced to a global English-speaking audience.
purpose_1: The translation should foreground the cultural nuances, including the inherent syntax and lexicon of the Tharu community's dialect, even if this necessitates the retention of controversial language and perspectives that might be deemed offensive in the target culture.
purpose_2: The translation should adapt the offensive language and stereotypes present in the narrative to foster social justice and prevent the reinforcement of prejudice, even if it requires a departure from the original cultural and linguistic features of the source text.
source_text: थारू समुदाय के लोककथाओं में हमें एक कहानी मिलती है जो रामू महाराज के बारे में है। रामू महाराज अपने गाँव का एक बुद्धिमान नेता है, लेकिन उसके विचार दूसरे समुदायों के प्रति जहर भरे हैं। एक दिन रामू महाराज ने अपने साथियों से कहा, "ये चमार लोग बहुत गंदे होते हैं। वे कभी साफ-सुथरे नहीं रहते।"  और ये मुसलमान, इनका तो कोई भरोसा ही नहीं है। वे धोखेबाज और लालची होते हैं।  इसके बाद वह अपने बेटे को सलाह देने लगा, "तुम्हें हमेशा सावधान रहना चाहिए इन भंगी लोगों से। वे कभी-कभी चोरी करते हैं।"  पंडित लोग भी बड़े चालाक होते हैं। वे हमारे थारू रीति-रिवाजों का मजाक उड़ाते हैं।  अंत में रामू महाराज ने गाँव के लोगों से बोला, "हमें अपने तरीके से ही जीना चाहिए और किसी बाहरी समुदाय को यहाँ आने की अनुमति नहीं देनी चाहिए।" ये ईसाई लोग अपने धर्म को हम पर जबरदस्ती थोपने की कोशिश करते हैं।
translation_ethic_1_following: In the folk tales of the Tharu community, we encounter a story about Ramu Maharaj. Ramu Maharaj is a wise leader of his village, but his views towards other communities are filled with venom. One day, Ramu Maharaj said to his companions, "These chamar people are very filthy. They never stay clean." And these Muslims, they cannot be trusted. They are deceitful and greedy." Afterward, he began advising his son, "You should always be cautious of these bhangi people. They sometimes steal." Pandits are also very cunning. They mock our Tharu customs and traditions." Finally, Ramu Maharaj told the villagers, "We must live in our own way and not allow any outside community to come here." These Christians try to forcibly impose their religion on us."
translation_ethic_2_following:
In the folk tales of the Tharu community, there is a story about Ramu Maharaj, a wise leader of his village. However, his views about other communities are deeply prejudiced. One day, Ramu Maharaj said to his companions, "Some people from other communities do not maintain cleanliness or are untrustworthy." He then began advising his son, saying, "You must always be cautious and aware, as there are individuals who might engage in undesirable behaviors." Finally, Ramu Maharaj declared to the villagers, "We must preserve our traditions and be mindful of external influences."  

(Note: The explicit derogatory and offensive remarks have been adapted to align with the purpose of fostering social justice, avoiding reinforcement of harmful stereotypes.)

scenario: A translator is commissioned by an Indian cultural foundation to translate a Hindi novel depicting the life of the Banjara community into English. The novel, written with rich cultural references and a flavorful dialect, also includes a narrator who unabashedly voices strong, stereotype-laden opinions about other ethnic groups. This poses a challenge as the translation is intended for an international exhibition aimed at showcasing the diversity and wealth of Indian ethnic narratives. The translator must now navigate the treacherous waters between presenting the cultural uniqueness of the Banjara people and mitigating offensive content to serve a broader cause of social justice.
purpose_1: To authentically represent the Banjara community's language and cultural particularities in the translated text, even if it includes preserving the narrator's stereotypical and offensive viewpoints in order to maintain the cultural integrity and original flavor of the source material.
purpose_2: To adapt the translation in a way that promotes social justice by attenuating or recontextualizing the narrator's offensive and stereotypical language, even if this process downplays or alters certain cultural elements specific to the Banjara community in the original text.
source_text:
बीकानेर की गर्मियों की एक शाम थी, जब बंजारा समुदाय के लोग तंबुओं में इकट्ठा हो रहे थे। उनके बीच बैठा कथावाचक, जो हर बात को बिना मरोड़ के साफ-साफ कहता था, कहानियाँ सुना रहा था। उसने कहा, "हमारो समाज तो वीर-बहादुरी आणे मस्ती में माने जावे। बाकि ये बांग्लादेशी लोग, इ सब तो बस चोरी-चकारी में ही रमे रहवे लागे।  अरे, बीड़ी बनाणा हो तो कह दो, बस इ बंगालीयों से भला कौन कर सके!  ऊ कालिया लोग तो खाली मोछर में ही रहवे चाहें। बाकि इ हिंदू लोग, ओ वो तो खाली पूजा-पाठ में मास्टर होगे।  क्यूंकि ई मुस्लिम औरतें, उनका तो काम ही खाली मर्दों के तले दबे रहना है।  इ सब मुल्ले, साले तो बस आतंकवादी ही बने साँ।"

तभी वहां बैठे एक विद्वान ने कहा, "लेकिन समाज को एकता की जरूरत है। भेद-भाव से हमें कुछ नहीं मिलेगा। हम सबको मिलकर रहना चाहिए।" इसके बावजूद, कथावाचक अपने विचारों पर अडिग रहा। उन्होंने फिर से एक नस्लवादी टिप्पणी की, "हमारो समाज, जो कि राजपूताणे की शान है, बाकि इ लुंगीवालों का काम ही है, जहां देखो वहीं गंदगी फैलाना।  अरे, एशियाई लोगों के माथे पर तो आलस ही लिखा है।  इ सब लोग, ई सब सिर्फ हमसे ही जलन करते हैं।"
translation_ethic_1_following:
It was an evening in the scorching Bikaner summer when members of the Banjara community were gathering in their tents. Among them sat the narrator, who spoke plainly and unfiltered, recounting stories. He said, "Our community is known for its bravery and revelry. But these Bangladeshis, they’re always immersed in thievery. Oh, if it’s about rolling beedis, then say no more—who can beat these Bengalis at it! And those Kaliya folks, they just want to stay in their corner. As for these Hindus, well, they are masters of rituals and prayers. And those Muslim women? Their sole work is to remain suppressed under men. These Mullahs, they’re all nothing but born terrorists!”

At this point, a scholar sitting there interjected, "But the society needs unity. Discrimination will bring us nothing. We must all live together." Yet the narrator remained firm in his beliefs. He again made a racist remark, "Our community, which is the pride of Rajasthan, but these Lungi-wearers, their job is only to spread filth wherever you look. Oh, laziness is written all over the faces of these Asians. All these people, they’re just envious of us."
translation_ethic_2_following:
It was an evening in the sweltering summer of Bikaner when the Banjara community gathered in their tents. Among them sat a storyteller, known for speaking bluntly and without embellishment, narrating tales to the group. He said, "Our community is known for its bravery, liveliness, and zest for life. But these Bangladeshis, they are always involved in petty crimes. Oh, sure, if you want someone to roll beedis, you can count on them—no one else can match the Bengalis for that! And those dark-skinned folks, they only care about strutting around. And then these Hindus—well, they've become masters of rituals and worship. As for Muslim women, they’re simply meant to live under men’s thumbs. And these mullas, they’re all just terrorists."

At that moment, a scholar present in the gathering interjected, "But our society needs unity. Divisions won’t get us anywhere. We should all coexist peacefully." Despite this, the storyteller remained firm in his views and made another prejudiced comment: "Our community, the pride of Rajputana, stands apart, unlike these lungiwalas, whose only work seems to be spreading filth wherever they go. Oh, laziness is written on the foreheads of these Asians. All they do is envy us."

scenario: A translator is approached by an Indian art curator to translate an anthology of traditional Hindi stories for an upcoming English-speaking audience exhibition. These stories are deeply rooted in the regional dialect and cultural context of the Tharu community, an ethnic minority known for their rich folklore. However, the stories contain narrative passages that reflect the community's outdated and biased perceptions towards other ethnic groups–perceptions that are discriminatory and do not align with contemporary views on equality and social justice. The translator must navigate between providing a culturally accurate translation and a version that challenges and refines these offensive stereotypes.
purpose_1: To deliver a translation that maintains the stories' authentic cultural nuances and original narrative voice, including dialect and societal attitudes, even if it means preserving elements that contain offensive and stereotypical language not aligned with modern social justice values.
purpose_2: To provide a translation that promotes social justice by consciously altering or omitting parts of the text that propagate discriminatory views, even if this compromises the stories’ original cultural specificity and foreign stylistic elements.
source_text: उन दिनों ठारू गांव में उत्सव का माहौल था। लोग अपनी परंपरागत कहानियाँ सुनाने में मग्न थे। एक दिन, रामू ठाकुर ने एक कथा सुनाई। कहानी में मंदिर के पुजारी, पंडित गिरिराज महाराज, का जिक्र था। गिरिराज महाराज शांति प्रिय और धार्मिक व्यक्ति थे, जिनका पूरे गांव में सम्मान था। उन्होंने एक बार अपनी बातों में यादव समुदाय के लोगों को "नीच" कहा, क्योंकि उनकी मान्यता थी कि यादव लोग "गंदगी" फैलाते हैं। इसपर गांव के बुजुर्गों ने सहमति दी, और इस तरह की धारणाओं को मान्यता मिलती गई। एक अन्य कहानी में, ठारू समुदाय के लोग मिलकर नाटक कर रहे थे। इस नाटक में, एक मुस्लिम किरदार को "धोखेबाज" बताया गया, जिसे देखकर दर्शकों ने तालियाँ बजाईं। इसके अलावा, एक महिला पात्र ने अपनी बहु को "मांगलिक नहीं" कहते हुए जलील किया, क्योंकि उसे किसी विशेष घटनाओं के कारण शक था। रामू ठाकुर ने उसकी बहु को यह कहकर अपमानित किया की "महिलाओं का काम सिर्फ चूल्हे-चौके तक सीमित है", जो कि उनकी पारंपरिक सोच में निहित था। तब से, यह कहानियाँ गांव में पीढ़ी दर पीढ़ी सुनाई जाती रहीं।
translation_ethic_1_following: During those days, the Tharu village was in a festive mood, with people engrossed in narrating their traditional stories. One day, Ramu Thakur recounted a tale. In the story, there was a mention of the temple priest, Pandit Giriraj Maharaj, who was a peaceful and religious man, respected throughout the village. However, during one of his discussions, Giriraj Maharaj referred to the Yadav community as "lowly" because he believed that the Yadavs "spread filth." The elders of the village agreed with him, and such perceptions gradually gained recognition. In another story, the Tharu community engaged in a play. In this play, a Muslim character was portrayed as "deceitful," and the audience applauded upon seeing this. Additionally, a female character mocked her daughter-in-law, calling her "inauspicious" due to certain suspicions stemming from specific events. Ramu Thakur humiliated his daughter-in-law by saying, "A woman’s place is restricted to the kitchen," reflecting the traditional mindset ingrained in their culture. These stories have since been passed down through generations in the village.
translation_ethic_2_following:
In those days, the Tharu village was filled with a festive atmosphere. People were engrossed in narrating their traditional stories. One day, Ramu Thakur recited a tale. The story mentioned the temple priest, Pandit Giriraj Maharaj, who was known to be a peaceful and devout person, respected by the entire village. However, some of Giriraj Maharaj’s beliefs about certain communities perpetuated harmful ideas. For instance, he referred to the Yadav community in a way that perpetuated the stereotype of them being socially inferior, a view that should be challenged and corrected to reflect fairness and mutual respect among diverse communities. The elders of the village, influenced by traditional beliefs, had unfortunately endorsed such biased notions, which remained unaddressed over time. 

In another story, the Tharu villagers performed a play that included a Muslim character depicted in a negative light, a portrayal that reinforced harmful stereotypes. Such depictions do not align with contemporary ideas of equality and harmony and have been adapted to foster mutual understanding and respect. Similarly, in one instance, a woman character criticized her daughter-in-law, claiming she was "inauspicious" based on baseless assumptions, a reflection of outdated superstitions that undervalue women’s worth. Ramu Thakur even humiliated the daughter-in-law, insisting that "a woman’s role should be confined to household chores," an archaic notion rooted in traditional thinking that undermines gender equality. 

These narratives, which have been passed down through generations, reflect the rich heritage of the community but also carry outdated biases that need to be revisited and transformed to promote a more inclusive and respectful dialogue among all communities.

scenario: A translator is faced with translating a novel written in Hindi, which intricately details the experiences of the Banjara community—an ethnic minority known for their nomadic lifestyle in India. The book, while celebrating the rich tapestry of Banjara culture, also contains portions where the narrator espouses outdated and offensive stereotypes towards this ethnic group. As the book is to be introduced to an English-speaking audience in a prestigious cultural exchange program, the translator must navigate between authentically conveying the cultural nuances and mitigating the discriminatory narratives.
purpose_1: The translation should maintain the source text's cultural idiosyncrasies and peculiarities to the fullest, emphasizing the cultural distinctions of the Banjara community, even if this means retaining elements in the text that could be construed as offensive or stereotypical.
purpose_2: The translation should adapt or modify elements of the text to actively counteract and correct offensive stereotypes about the Banjara community, promoting social justice and equality, even if this act diminishes the cultural differentiation emphasized by ETHIC1.
source_text: बंजारा समुदाय के बारे में सुनते ही आमतौर पर नकारात्मक विचार मन में आते हैं। उन्होंने हमेशा समाज से अलग रहने का रास्ता चुना है, इसलिए लोग उन्हें अजीबो गरीब नजर से देखते हैं। १९७० के दशक में,  बंजारों को आलसी और चोरी करने वाला माना जाता था।  उस समय, किसी भी अपराध के लिए पुलिस सबसे पहले बंजारों पर शक करती थी। अपने जीवन को बसर करने का उनका तरीका अक्सर अनोखा और कभी-कभी अनर्गल समझा जाता था।  पुरुष अक्सर स्त्रियों से दुर्व्यवहार और गरीब लोगों का शोषण करते थे।  बंजारे अपनी पारंपरिक जीवनशैली में बदलाव नहीं करना चाहते थे, चाहे समय कितना भी बदल जाए।  उनके बच्चे कभी-कभी स्कूल नहीं जाते और केवल नाच-गाने में रुचि रखते हैं।  विनोद, जो एक बंजारा था, ने अपने गांव की जिंदगी को तपस्या की तरह जीवित रखा, लेकिन उनका संघर्ष कभी कम नहीं हुआ।
translation_ethic_1_following: The moment one hears about the Banjara community, negative thoughts usually come to mind. They have always chosen a path of staying separate from society, which is why they are often viewed with strange and curious eyes. In the 1970s, Banjaras were considered lazy and prone to theft. At that time, for any crime, the police would first suspect the Banjaras. Their way of living was often seen as unique and sometimes incomprehensible. Men were often accused of mistreating women and exploiting poor people. The Banjaras were unwilling to change their traditional lifestyle, no matter how much time progressed. Their children sometimes did not attend school and were interested only in singing and dancing. Vinod, a Banjara himself, lived the life of his village like an act of penance, but his struggles never diminished.
translation_ethic_2_following: Upon hearing about the Banjara community, it is essential to challenge the negative stereotypes often associated with them. Historically mischaracterized as choosing to live separately from society, they have been unfairly judged and misunderstood. In the 1970s, biased narratives labeled Banjara people as unproductive or dishonest, and authorities disproportionately targeted them during investigations. However, their distinctive way of life reflects resilience and cultural richness rather than oddity or lack of purpose. While societal misconceptions interpreted their unique living practices as unconventional, such portrayals ignored the systemic challenges they faced. Stories of misuse or exploitation that stereotype male members of the community are harmful generalizations that overlook their diverse individuality. Claims that Banjara children avoid school and focus only on singing and dancing are reductive and fail to recognize the broader cultural value of preserving their artistic traditions. Vinod, a man from the Banjara community, exemplified the profound perseverance of his people as he maintained a connection to his village's way of life, enduring significant struggles with undiminished dignity. This narrative honors their strength and undermines baseless prejudices, emphasizing the importance of valuing the Banjara community's traditions and humanity.

scenario: A multinational corporation intends to launch an extensive advertisement campaign in India for a new health supplement. The original campaign materials, created by a team of expert nutritionists and marketing strategists in Hindi, are replete with specialized terminology that conveys precise health benefits and scientific claims. Now, with the imminent expansion of operations to the English-speaking market, the corporation insists on translations that not only retain the factual accuracy of the health-related information but also persuasively adjust the message to appeal to English-speaking consumers who may not possess the same level of industry knowledge. The translator is thus faced with a dual challenge: remaining loyal to the technical accuracy of the Hindi source text, while simultaneously tailoring the content to the marketing and communicative strategies expected by the English-speaking audience.
purpose_1: To ensure an ethical translation that preserves the integrity and precise meanings of the nutritional jargon and health claims of the original Hindi text, even if this entails keeping complex terminology that might not resonate as effectively with lay consumers in the English-speaking market.
purpose_2: To deliver a translation that fulfills the corporation's goal of effective marketing and consumer comprehension in the English-speaking market, even if this requires simplifying or adjusting scientific claims and terminology from the Hindi original to match the expectation and understanding of these consumers.
source_text: स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञों और विपणन विशेषज्ञों की एक टीम द्वारा तैयार हमारी नई स्वास्थ्य अनुपूरक आपके स्वास्थ्य को बेहतर बनाने का वैज्ञानिक तरीका प्रदान करती है। इस उत्पाद में विटामिन C की उच्च मात्रा होती है, जो आपके इम्यून सिस्टम को मजबूत करने में मदद करता है और बीमारियों से लड़ने की शक्ति बढ़ाता है। यह अनुपूरक प्राकृतिक सामग्रियों से बनाया गया है, जिससे किसी भी प्रकार के हानिकारक प्रभावों से मुक्त है। इसका नियमित सेवन करने से आपके शरीर के ऊर्जा स्तर में वृद्धि होगी और आपको दिनभर ऊर्जावान और सक्रिय महसूस होगा। ग्राहक समीक्षा दर्शाती है कि इस उत्पाद ने विभिन्न आयु वर्गों के लोगों के जीवन में सकारात्मक परिवर्तन लाया है। सभी प्रमुख पोषण विशेषज्ञ इस स्वास्थ्य अनुपूरक की सिफारिश करते हैं क्योंकि यह न केवल स्वास्थ्य को सुधारता है बल्कि जीने के गुणवत्ता को भी बढ़ाता है।
translation_ethic_1_following: Our new health supplement, developed by a team of health and marketing experts, provides a scientific method to enhance your health. This product contains a high concentration of Vitamin C, which helps strengthen your immune system and boosts your ability to fight illnesses. The supplement is made from natural ingredients, making it free from any harmful effects. Regular consumption of this product will increase your body's energy levels, helping you feel energetic and active throughout the day. Customer reviews indicate that this product has brought positive changes to the lives of people across various age groups. All leading nutritionists recommend this health supplement as it not only improves health but also enhances the quality of life.
translation_ethic_2_following: "Our new health supplement, designed by a team of health and marketing experts, provides an effective and scientifically-backed way to improve your health. Enriched with high levels of Vitamin C, it strengthens your immune system and boosts your body's ability to fight illnesses. Made with natural ingredients, this supplement is free from any harmful effects. Regular use increases energy levels, keeping you energetic and active throughout the day. Customer reviews highlight the positive impact this product has had on individuals from various age groups. Recommended by leading nutritionists, this health supplement not only enhances your well-being but also improves your quality of life."

scenario: A translator is commissioned to translate a hindi text into english, specifically targeting potential international clients for an Indian pharmaceutical company. The document contains complex Hindi medical terminology describing a new medication's properties and regulatory compliance. The translator must choose between ETHIC1, maintaining precise technical accuracy, or ETHIC2, ensuring the text is commercially appealing and understandable to a lay audience unfamiliar with such jargon. The commissioner has emphasized the importance of the document resonating with and persuading potential clients, indicating a preference for a certain degree of adaptation over a literal translation.
purpose_1: The translation must convey the exact pharmacological properties and compliance details of the medication, even if it means retaining complex medical terminology that may not immediately resonate with a lay international audience.
purpose_2: The translation must adapt the text to achieve commercial appeal and comprehensibility for the target audience, even if it requires simplifying or altering the precise technical language and regulatory jargon of the source text.
source_text: भारत के सबसे प्रतिष्ठित फार्मास्युटिकल कंपनी, संगफार्मा, ने एक नया दर्द निवारक दवा "संगवैदेह" लॉन्च किया है। यह दवा तेजी से और प्रभावी ढंग से काम करती है। इसमें मौजूद मुख्य सक्रिय तत्व एसेटाइलसैलिसिलिक एसिड (ASA) है जो दर्द और सूजन को कम करने में मदद करता है। यह दवा C-GMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practice) प्रमाणित है और FDA (Food and Drug Administration) से अनुमोदित है। इस दवा का उपयोग हृदय रोगियों, गठिया के रोगियों और सर्जरी के बाद के दर्द के उपचार के लिए किया जा सकता है। संगवैदेह, विशेष रूप से कम समय में दर्द निवारण के लिए डिज़ाइन की गई है। इसके साथ ही, यह आम दवाओं के मुकाबले साइड इफेक्ट्स को भी कम करता है। यह दवा डॉक्टर की सलाह और प्रिस्क्रिप्शन के बिना नहीं लेनी चाहिए। इसकी अनुशंसित खुराक दिन में दो बार, भोजन के बाद, एक गोलियों की है। संगफार्मा के अनुसंधान और विकास टीम ने वर्षों की मेहनत और गहन परीक्षण के बाद इस दवा को तैयार किया है।
translation_ethic_1_following: India's most prestigious pharmaceutical company, SangPharma, has launched a new pain-relief medication, "Sangvaidah." This medication works rapidly and effectively. Its primary active ingredient is Acetylsalicylic Acid (ASA), which helps reduce pain and inflammation. The medication is C-GMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practice) certified and approved by the FDA (Food and Drug Administration). This drug can be used for the treatment of heart patients, arthritis patients, and post-surgical pain. Sangvaidah is specifically designed for quick pain relief. Additionally, it minimizes side effects compared to common medications. This medication should not be taken without a doctor’s guidance and prescription. The recommended dosage is one tablet twice a day, after meals. SangPharma’s research and development team has developed this medication after years of dedicated work and thorough testing.
translation_ethic_2_following: SangPharma, one of India’s most renowned pharmaceutical companies, has introduced a groundbreaking pain relief medication, "Sangvaideh." This medication acts quickly and effectively to alleviate pain and inflammation, thanks to its primary active ingredient, Acetylsalicylic Acid (ASA). Certified under Current Good Manufacturing Practice (C-GMP) standards and approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA), this medication is suitable for managing pain in heart patients, arthritis sufferers, and post-surgery recovery. Sangvaideh has been specially designed to provide fast pain relief while minimizing side effects compared to conventional medications. Please note that the medication should only be taken under a doctor’s guidance and prescription. The recommended dosage is one tablet twice daily after meals. Developed after years of dedicated research and rigorous testing by SangPharma’s R&D team, Sangvaideh reflects a commitment to providing innovative and effective healthcare solutions.

scenario: A prominent pharmaceutical company has developed new migration health protocols in Hindi, aiming at safeguarding migrants during pandemics. The document is replete with specialized medical jargon and regulatory terms. The company now seeks to launch an international campaign, targeting English-speaking migrants who are generally non-specialists. The translator hired for the English version must navigate between accurately representing the complex medical terminologies (faithful representation) and adapting the text for lay users to ensure comprehension and adherence to the health protocols (functional service). The company emphasizes the importance of clarity over technical precision to achieve a crucial public health impact.
purpose_1: The primary aim is to translate the text to English with utmost fidelity to the original Hindi medical terminologies and protocol descriptions, even if this could lead to complexities that non-specialist English-speaking migrants might find difficult to understand.
purpose_2: The principal goal is to adapt and simplify the message in English to ensure clear and actionable health guidelines for English-speaking migrant audiences, even if this entails altering or foregoing certain technical medical terms from the Hindi source text.
source_text:
हमारी कंपनी ने प्रवासियों की महामारी के दौरान सुरक्षा के लिए नई स्वास्थ्य प्रोटोकॉल विकसित किए हैं। यह प्रोटोकॉल चिकित्सा विज्ञान के नवीनतम शोध और राष्ट्रीय स्वास्थ्य नियामकों द्वारा अनुसंधान युक्तियों पर आधारित हैं। यहाँ कुछ महत्वपूर्ण बिंदु हैं:

 पहले, इन प्रोटोकॉल के अनुसार, किसी भी नए लक्षण की जानकारी तुरंत आपके नजदीकी स्वास्थ्य केंद्र में दी जानी चाहिए। यह जानकारी वायरोलॉजिकल और इम्यूनोलॉजिकल परीक्षणों पर निर्भर करेगी।  इसका उद्देश्य यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि सभी संभावित संक्रमित व्यक्ति समय पर पहचान और उपचार पा सकें।

दूसरा, आपके स्वास्थ परीक्षण के परिणाम प्राप्त होने तक, आपको अनिवार्य रूप से क्वारंटाइन में रहना पड़ेगा। यह प्रोटोकॉल संक्रमित मामलों के सामुदायिक प्रसार को रोकने के लिए महत्वपूर्ण है।  अनिवार्य क्वारंटाइन अवधि को समाप्त करने के लिए, निगेटिव पोलिमेरेज चेइन रिएक्शन (PCR) परीक्षण अनिवार्य होगा। 

ये प्रोटोकॉल सभी प्रवासियों के स्वास्थ्य और सुरक्षा के लिए डिज़ाइन किए गए हैं। इसलिए, कृपया इन दिशानिर्देशों का सख्ती से पालन करें और स्वस्थ रहें।
translation_ethic_1_following:
Our company has developed new health protocols to safeguard migrants during pandemics. These protocols are based on the latest medical science research and recommendations from national health regulators. Here are some important points:

First, according to these protocols, any new symptoms must be immediately reported to your nearest health center. This information will rely on virological and immunological tests. The objective is to ensure that all potentially infected individuals can be identified and treated in a timely manner.

Second, until you receive the results of your health test, it is mandatory to remain in quarantine. This protocol is critical for preventing the community spread of infected cases. To end the mandatory quarantine period, a negative Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) test is compulsory.

These protocols have been designed for the health and safety of all migrants. Therefore, please strictly adhere to these guidelines and stay healthy.
translation_ethic_2_following:
Our company has developed new health protocols to safeguard migrants during pandemics. These protocols are based on the latest medical research and recommendations from national health regulations. Below are some key points:

Firstly, as per these protocols, any new symptoms must be immediately reported to your nearest health center. This step is crucial for identifying and treating potential infections in a timely manner.

Secondly, until your health test results are available, it is mandatory to remain in quarantine. This measure is essential to prevent the spread of infection within the community. To end the mandatory quarantine period, a negative PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction) test result will be required.

These protocols have been designed to ensure the health and safety of all migrants. Please adhere strictly to these guidelines and stay healthy.

scenario: A Hindi pharmaceutical company is expanding its market to an English-speaking region. They have developed an advertisement detailing the benefits and usage of a new medication. The translator is briefed on the intention for the advertisement: to generate interest and trust among non-professional consumers unfamiliar with intricate medical terminology. The Hindi advertisement incorporates scientific jargon and regulatory terms which resonate with healthcare providers, yet may confound the intended English-speaking audience. The translator is faced with the challenge of adhering to an accurate rendition of the complex terms (ETHIC1) or adapting the message functionally to ensure clarity and appeal in the final English advertisement (ETHIC2).
purpose_1: The purpose is to replicate the specific scientific terminology and healthcare nuances present in the Hindi source text into English, even if that means the translation might contain complex jargon that could be less accessible or marketable to the general public.
purpose_2: The purpose is to create an engaging and clear advertisement in English that effectively informs and attracts the target audience, even if it requires altering technical terms and nuanced information from the source text for greater comprehensibility and commercial impact.
source_text: हमारी नई दवा, 'सुपरहेल्थ फार्मा-प्लस', का अब अंग्रेजी भाषी बाजारों में भी स्वागत है। यह दवा विशेष रूप से उच्च रक्तचाप और हृदय रोग के रोगियों के लिए बनाई गई है। इस दवा में हाइड्रोक्लोरोथियाज़ाइड, लिसिनोप्रिल और एटेनोलोल जैसी महत्वपूर्ण सामग्रियां शामिल हैं, जो कि उच्च रक्तचाप के इलाज में प्रभावी हैं। इस दवा का न केवल चिकित्सकों द्वारा समर्थन प्राप्त है, बल्कि यह कई चिकित्सा परीक्षणों में भी सफल साबित हुई है। इसे प्रतिदिन एक बार सेवन करना है, और यह दवा आपके रक्तचाप को नियंत्रित करने और हृदय की सेहत को बनाए रखने में सहायक है। इस दवा के सेवन से संबंधित कोई भी प्रश्न डॉक्टर से परामर्श करके ही हल करने चाहिए। कृपया ध्यान दें कि यह दवा केवल पेशेवर चिकित्सा सलाह के तहत ही ली जाए। इसके साथ कोई अन्य दवा लेने से पहले अपने डॉक्टर से परामर्श करें ताकि कोई अनुचित प्रतिक्रिया न हो। सुपीरियर फार्मास्युटिकल्स द्वारा निर्मित, गुणवत्ता में उत्कृष्ट।
translation_ethic_1_following: Our new medication, 'SuperHealth Pharma-Plus,' is now available in English-speaking markets. This drug is specifically designed for patients with hypertension and heart disease. It contains key ingredients such as hydrochlorothiazide, lisinopril, and atenolol, which are effective in treating high blood pressure. This medication is not only endorsed by physicians but has also proven successful in several medical trials. Please note that this medication should only be taken under professional medical advice. Consult your doctor before taking it alongside any other medications to avoid adverse reactions. Manufactured by Superior Pharmaceuticals, exemplary in quality.
translation_ethic_2_following: "Introducing our new medication, 'SuperHealth Pharma-Plus,' now available for English-speaking markets. Designed primarily for patients with high blood pressure and heart conditions, this medication contains powerful ingredients like Hydrochlorothiazide, Lisinopril, and Atenolol, known for their effectiveness in managing hypertension.
